report_name: SilentRansomGroup Claims Attack on Law Firm Mayer Brown

threat_actors.name: SilentRansomGroup
threat_actors.description: A ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) group that emerged in mid-2025. The group listed the law firm Mayer Brown on its dark web leak site, claiming a successful ransomware attack and data exfiltration, though the claim is unsubstantiated. The group has a history of making unverified claims.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion of victims through double extortion ransomware schemes.

identities.name: Mayer Brown
identities.description: A major international law firm listed as an alleged victim on the SilentRansomGroup's dark web leak site in an unconfirmed ransomware attack claim.

infrastructure.name: SilentRansomGroup Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by SilentRansomGroup to publicize claims of attacks, list victims, and threaten to publish exfiltrated data to pressure victims into paying a ransom.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2c1b9e3a-4f8d-4a1e-8b6c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/silentransomgroup-ransomware-claim-targets-mayer-brown/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity, though rare.
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a command-line pattern for vssadmin.exe deleting volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique suggested for hunting in the article.

indicators.name: PsExec Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: PsExec Execution
id: 8d3f5c1a-9e2b-4a7d-8c1b-6a9e3d5f8b2a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PsExec, which can be used by adversaries for lateral movement.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/silentransomgroup-ransomware-claim-targets-mayer-brown/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.lateral_movement
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use by system administrators.
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'PsExec.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of psexec.exe, a tool mentioned in the article's hunting hints for detecting ransomware precursor activity.

indicators.name: Ransomware File Creation with .locked Extension
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Creation with .locked Extension
id: f4a9b8c7-6d5e-4f3a-2b1c-0d9e8f7a6b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the .locked extension, a common indicator of ransomware activity.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/silentransomgroup-ransomware-claim-targets-mayer-brown/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-08
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
falsepositives:
  - Unlikely, but possible with legitimate software that uses this extension.
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.locked'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with a '.locked' extension, a hunting hint provided in the article for identifying potential ransomware activity.
